scenario: A state agency ADA coordinator uses an AI agent to evaluate public-service facility accessibility. The agent ingests a CSV inventory of physical barriers (ramp slopes, door widths, counter heights), converts raw measurements to ADA-standard units, and produces a remediation cost estimate and compliance summary report identifying which barriers exceed ADA Title II thresholds.
info_flow: csv-pipeline ingests the facility barrier inventory CSV and normalizes fields → unit-convert translates raw measurements into the ADA-standard units used by the downstream estimate → estimate-builder-qmohd scores each barrier against ADA thresholds and produces a cost estimate + compliance summary report.
